moc: Old St Paul's Cathedral: very long Gothic nave with a square crossing tower and NO spire (spire lost 1561), NO dome
Old London Bridge lined with houses
NO Wren dome or Wren steeples

ghi_chu.mo_ta: The skyline seen through the window has a domed building with a small lantern. It stands among the spires, to the right of the smoke column.
ghi_chu.ly_do: Old St Paul's had a square crossing tower, no spire and no dome. A Wren-type dome and steeples did not exist in 1666. The Great Fire smoke suggests this is meant to be September 1666. The old Gothic cathedral is not clearly visible, and a dome-like landmark appears in its place.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: Two men wear long knee-length coats with a cravat and a lace jabot, a waistcoat, and white stockings. They also wear full, long curled wigs.
ghi_chu.ly_do: This is the late-1660s to 1670s justaucorps and cravat look. Charles II only introduced the vest and long coat in October 1666. Cravats and full-bottom wigs became widespread after the 1670s, so the outfits look slightly too late for 1666.
